title: MAINT: Use `comm` in `MaxwellBoltzmannDistribution` instead of `communicator`
body:
This is a follow up of !3631.

In the present ASE, `comm` is used as
```
% git grep "comm="
ase/build/attach.py:                                  comm=world):
ase/build/attach.py:        broadcast(joined, 0, comm=comm)
ase/calculators/dftd3.py:                 comm=world,
ase/calculators/dftd3.py:        dftd3 = PureDFTD3(label=label, command=command, comm=comm, **kwargs)
ase/calculators/dftd3.py:                 comm=world,
ase/calculators/dftd3.py:        dct = broadcast(dct, root=0, comm=self.comm)
ase/calculators/lammpslib.py:        comm=None)
ase/calculators/lammpslib.py:                              comm=self.parameters.comm)
ase/calculators/qmmm.py:                 vacuum=None, embedding=None, output=None, comm=world):
ase/calculators/qmmm.py:        self.output = self.openfile(file=output, comm=comm)
ase/calculators/socketio.py:                 unixsocket=None, timeout=None, log=None, comm=world):
ase/calculators/socketio.py:                 launch_client=None, comm=world):
ase/calculators/socketio.py:        self.log = self.openfile(file=log, comm=comm)
ase/calculators/vdwcorrection.py:                 txt=None, sR=None, comm=world):
ase/calculators/vdwcorrection.py:        self.txt = self.openfile(file=txt, comm=self.comm)
ase/dft/dos.py:    def __init__(self, calc, width=0.1, window=None, npts=401, comm=world):
ase/dft/dos.py:                                                 self.energies, comm=self.comm)
ase/dft/dos.py:                                   weights=None, comm=world):
ase/io/trajectory.py:               comm=world):
ase/io/trajectory.py:                            comm=comm)
ase/io/trajectory.py:                 master=None, comm=world):
ase/md/logger.py:        comm=world,
ase/md/logger.py:        self.logfile = self.openfile(file=logfile, mode=mode, comm=comm)
ase/mep/dimer.py:    def __init__(self, logfile='-', eigenmode_logfile=None, comm=world,
ase/mep/dimer.py:        self.initialize_logfiles(comm=comm, logfile=logfile,
ase/mep/dimer.py:        self.logfile = self.openfile(file=logfile, comm=comm)
ase/mep/dimer.py:                                               comm=comm)
ase/mep/dimer.py:                 random_seed=None, comm=world, **kwargs):
ase/mep/dimer.py:            self.control.initialize_logfiles(comm=comm, logfile=logfile,
ase/optimize/optimize.py:        comm=world,
ase/optimize/optimize.py:        self.logfile = self.openfile(file=logfile, comm=comm, mode='a')
ase/optimize/optimize.py:                    trajectory, mode=mode, master=master, comm=comm
ase/parallel.py:def paropen(name, mode='r', buffering=-1, encoding=None, comm=None):
ase/parallel.py:    def __init__(self, mpi4py_comm=None):
ase/parallel.py:def broadcast(obj, root=0, comm=world):
ase/phonons.py:                 delta=0.01, center_refcell=False, comm=None):
ase/test/factories.py:        lmp = lammps.lammps(name='', cmdargs=cmd_args, comm=None)
ase/utils/filecache.py:        return MultiFileJSONCache(directory, comm=comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:        return MultiFileULMCache(directory, comm=comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:    def __init__(self, directory, comm=world):
ase/utils/filecache.py:                                        comm=self.comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:    def __init__(self, directory, dct, comm=world):
ase/utils/filecache.py:        self.backend.open_and_write(target, self._dct, comm=self.comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:    def dump_cache(cls, path, dct, comm=world):
ase/utils/filecache.py:        cache = cls(path, dct, comm=comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:        cache = cls(path, {}, comm=comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:                                                    comm=self.comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:def get_json_cache(directory, comm=world):
ase/utils/filecache.py:        return CombinedJSONCache.load(directory, comm=comm)
ase/utils/filecache.py:        return MultiFileJSONCache(directory, comm=comm)
ase/vibrations/raman.py:                 comm=world,
ase/vibrations/raman.py:        self.txt = self.openfile(file=txt, comm=comm)
ase/vibrations/raman.py:                 comm=world,
ase/vibrations/raman.py:        self.txt = self.openfile(file=txt, comm=comm)
ase/vibrations/raman.py:            log = io.openfile(file=log, mode='a', comm=self.comm)
ase/vibrations/resonant_raman.py:                 comm=world,
```
While `communicator` is used only in `velocitydistribution.py`.
```
% git grep "communicator="
ase/md/velocitydistribution.py:def _maxwellboltzmanndistribution(masses, temp, communicator=None, rng=None):
ase/md/velocitydistribution.py:    communicator=None,
```
This MR suggests using `comm` also in `velocitydistribution.py` for consistency in whole ASE.

This MR also suggests to deprecate `None` and `serial` in `MaxwellBoltzmannDistribution`; particularly the latter can be replaced with explicit `DummyMPI()`.

@schiotz: May I again request your review, as this is also relevant to ASAP?

comments.author: schiotz
comments.body: Maybe we should take the opportunity and fix the spelling of 'Parameters' :-)
comments.label_reasoning: The comment points out a typo/spelling error in a docstring ('Parameters' misspelled), which is a documentation quality issue.

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body: Thank you for finding the typo! Fixed in the added commit.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests fixing a spelling error ('Parameters'), which implies a concrete code change.

comments.author: schiotz
comments.body: I think we should increment both version numbers by one, since 3.25.0 has been released since this MR was made (mea culpa).
comments.label_reasoning: The comment identifies incorrect version numbers in a deprecation warning that need to be updated to reflect the actual released version, which is a factual/logic error in the code.

comments.author: yuzie007

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests incrementing version numbers, which is a specific code change.
